metadata.title: Palantir Stock Climbs as Enterprise AI Demand Keeps Growing

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) stock gained 1% on Wednesday morning. The tech company is using a second AI Sovereignty Bootcamp to broaden engagement with organizations evaluating its artificial intelligence platforms, with nearly 100 groups attending Wednesday's event.
The latest gathering follows Palantir's first bootcamp on July 27. Together, the events have attracted nearly 200 unique organizations in less than a month, with participants including Dell, HCA Healthcare, SharkNinja and Zeta Global. Speakers from NVIDIA, Novartis, Cisco and NATO also took part.
The company's commercial expansion is another focus for investors. Palantir recently entered a partnership with Mercury Systems covering deployments across manufacturing and supply-chain operations. A bullish analyst report also reiterated a Buy rating, citing U.S. commercial total contract value growth of more than 150% year over year and remaining performance obligations that more than doubled.
The growing participation could support Palantir's commercial AI growth story, although its valuation remains an important consideration for investors.
